name: nook
description: Native browser primitives for popovers, tooltips, and selects.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nook/core build && pnpm --filter @nook/react build && pnpm --filter @nook/ui build && pnpm --filter @nook/ui-react build && pnpm --filter @nook/website build
scripts.check: prettier --check . && pnpm check:workspace-deps && pnpm lint && pnpm -r typecheck && node scripts/check-compiler.mjs packages/react packages/ui-react
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @nook/react test && pnpm --filter @nook/ui-react test && pnpm --filter @nook/website test
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/test-results packages/*/node_modules/.cache website/test-results website/.vitepress/cache website/.vitepress/dist bench/results
scripts.bench: pnpm --filter @nook/core build && pnpm --filter @nook/react build && node bench/check-compiled.mjs && node bench/run.mjs
